main.description: A single on-site endorsement cast by one Bluesky account for one of THE SLATE's 38 #bsky38 picks. One record per (voter, target) pair, never overwritten — the running tally and each voter's 10-endorsement cap (mirroring bsky38.com's own '10 votes' rule) are computed by clients watching Jetstream and scanning the network for this collection, not stored in the record itself. This is slate38.bisks.net's own parallel vote, separate from and not a substitute for actually casting a ballot at bsky38.com. Written and read by slate38 (https://slate38.bisks.net).

target.description: DID of the slate candidate being endorsed.

createdAt.description: When the endorsement was cast, as an ISO 8601 datetime.
